## mcrl alert-group create

Create a alert group setting.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert-group create [flags]

Aliases:
  create, new

Create a alert group setting from flags, or from a JSON or YAML file in the API's format
with -f. Flags override the file's fields.

API: POST /api/v0/alert-group-settings
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl alert-group create --name web --service web --notification-interval 1h
  mcrl alert-group create -f alert-group.yaml

Flags:
  -f, --file string                    JSON or YAML file in the API's format ("-" for stdin)
      --memo string                    memo
      --monitor stringArray            monitor scope, ID or name (repeatable; replaces the list)
      --name string                    name
      --notification-interval string   re-notify interval, e.g. "1h"
      --role stringArray               role scope as <service>:<role> (repeatable; replaces the list)
      --service stringArray            service scope (repeatable; replaces the list)
```

## mcrl alert-group delete

Delete a alert group setting.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert-group delete <alert-group-setting>

Aliases:
  delete, rm

Delete a alert group setting. The output is the deleted object.

API: DELETE /api/v0/alert-group-settings/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl alert-group delete web
  mcrl alert-group delete 3Ja1bAxcdef --yes
```

## mcrl alert-group edit

Edit a alert group setting in $EDITOR.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert-group edit <alert-group>

Open the current alert group setting as YAML in $VISUAL or $EDITOR (default vi), then
show the changes and send them after confirmation.

The whole object is sent back, including fields mcrl does not know about,
so nothing is lost. Read-only fields (id) are hidden. If the file does not
parse, the editor opens again with the error at the top. Saving an empty file
or leaving it unchanged cancels.

API: PUT /api/v0/alert-group-settings/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl alert-group-setting edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
  EDITOR='code --wait' mcrl alert-group-setting edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
```

## mcrl alert-group get

Show a alert group setting.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert-group get <alert-group>

Aliases:
  get, show

Show a alert group setting by ID or name.

A reference that looks like an ID (11 alphanumeric characters) is looked up
as an ID first. Prefix it with "id:" or "name:" to force either.

API: GET /api/v0/alert-group-settings/<id>, GET /api/v0/alert-group-settings
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl alert-group get web
  mcrl alert-group get 3Ja1bAxcdef
```


## mcrl alert-group update

Update a alert group setting.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl alert-group update <alert-group-setting> [flags]

Update a alert group setting. The current alert group setting is fetched and the flags (and -f fields) are
applied on top, so only the fields to change need to be given. --replace
sends the -f file as the complete object instead.

API: PUT /api/v0/alert-group-settings/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl alert-group update web --role web:app --role web:db
  mcrl alert-group update web --memo 'grouped by service'

Flags:
  -f, --file string                    JSON or YAML file with the fields to change ("-" for stdin)
      --memo string                    memo
      --monitor stringArray            monitor scope, ID or name (repeatable; replaces the list)
      --name string                    name
      --notification-interval string   re-notify interval, e.g. "1h"
      --replace[=true|false]           send the -f file as the complete object without merging
      --role stringArray               role scope as <service>:<role> (repeatable; replaces the list)
      --service stringArray            service scope (repeatable; replaces the list)
```
